name: Magic Weapon Warrior
body:
You trained to make optimal use of magic weapons.

Benefit(s): Whenever you roll a natural 20 (the die shows a “20”) on a combat maneuver check with a magic weapon, you gain a +5 trait bonus on the check.

Pathfinder Player Companion: Weapon Master’s Handbook © 2015, Paizo Inc.; Authors: Alexander Augunas and David N. Ross.
